This page is the interactive version of the lesson notes (PDF). Each section
is one step of the critique session. It ends with a **Do it** task and one
set of questions. The full explanations, examples and exercises are in the
notes.

## Key terms

{{< glossary audio-critique audio-mix ducking clipping visual-cue sound-variation mixer-group >}}

## 18.1 Listen with criteria

- Listen **twice**: as a player, then as a critic.
- Every note: a **moment** (0:42, or the event) and a **criterion**.
- Listen on a phone speaker and on headphones.
- Salma: 0:12 rain over steps (balance); 0:42 voice lost (clarity); 1:05
  warning only a sound (accessibility).

![The seven criteria.](images/quality-rubric.png){width=90%}

::: {.callout-warning title="Watch out!"}
A note without a moment cannot be found.
:::

::: {.callout-note title="Do it · Listen and note"}
Play your mix (or your loop) twice and write four notes, each with a moment
and a criterion.
:::

::: {.callout-tip title="Try it 1 · Notes"}
Which criterion?

::: {.match extra="colour|speed"}
0:12 — the rain covers the steps.
:   balance

0:42 — Nour's line is lost.
:   clarity

1:05 — the warning is only a sound.
:   accessibility

The swish never changes.
:   repetition
:::
:::

## 18.2 Give useful feedback

- **I hear** … (moment and sound) · **It matters because** … (the player)
  · **Try** … (one suggestion).
- About the **work**, not the person; honest and kind.

![Feedback in three parts.](images/critique-parts.png){width=90%}

{{< sim file="sims/critique-builder.html" poster="sims/critique-builder.png" title="Critique Builder: useful feedback on a mix" height="760" >}}

::: {.callout-warning title="Watch out!"}
"I do not like it" and "you are bad at this" give nothing to act on.
:::

::: {.callout-note title="Do it · Build and write"}
Build feedback that passes all checks in **Critique Builder**. Then turn
two of your own notes into feedback in three parts.
:::

::: {.callout-tip title="Try it 2 · Useful or not?"}
Choose the right answer.

::: {.match extra="useful, it is short|useful, it is honest"}
“The sound is bad.”
:   not useful: no moment, no suggestion

“At 0:42 the music covers Nour; try ducking it by 8 dB.”
:   useful

“Your mix is terrible.”
:   not useful: about the person

Which part says what the player loses?
:   it matters because …
:::
:::

## 18.3 Receive feedback and revise

- **Ask** about unclear notes: "Which moment? What did you miss?"
- **Sort:** game information first, then clipping and clicks, then taste.
- **Fix** one thing at a time; save version 2.
- **Compare** v1 and v2 at the same moment.

![From notes to version 2.](images/revision-loop.png){width=90%}

::: {.callout-warning title="Watch out!"}
Ten changes at once: nobody knows which one helped.
:::

::: {.callout-note title="Do it · Version 2"}
Fix the two most important notes in your mix, compare v1 and v2 at the same
moment, and write one sentence.
:::

::: {.callout-tip title="Try it 3 · Revising"}
Choose the right answer.

::: {.match extra="the newest note|the shortest note"}
Which note comes first?
:   a voice line that is lost

What do you ask about “Your mix is terrible”?
:   which moment, and what was missed

How many changes before you listen again?
:   one

How do you compare v1 and v2?
:   the same moment in both
:::
:::

## Game challenge: Critic's Choice {.challenge}

Work alone. Use every section of today.

The **critique session**: the rain of the flood level, the coin of
*Lantern Keeper*, the boss music of *Ember Trail*, a rude comment, and ten
notes at the end.

{{< sim file="sims/critics-choice.html" poster="sims/critics-choice.png" title="Critic's Choice: the most useful feedback" kind="game" height="560" >}}

::: {.callout-tip title="Try it 4 · The session"}
Choose the most useful feedback or step.

::: {.match extra="“Make it better.”|“Coins are boring.”"}
The rain covers the steps.
:   “Lower the rain by 4–6 dB so players hear the steps.”

The coin sound gets annoying.
:   “Add 3 takes and a ±5 % pitch change.”

The boss music starts with a hard cut.
:   “Start the boss layer on the next bar.”

Ten notes after the session.
:   sort them: game information first
:::
:::

::: {.callout-tip title="Try it 5 · The three parts (harder)"}
Which part of the feedback is it?

::: {.match extra="the person|the price"}
“At 1:05, the wave warning is only a sound.”
:   I hear …

“Players without sound will be hit by the wave.”
:   it matters because …

“Add a red arrow and the subtitle ‘Wave!’.”
:   try …
:::
:::

## Summary {.summary}

- Listen twice and note each problem with a moment and a criterion.
- Feedback in three parts: I hear …, it matters because …, try ….
- About the work, not the person.
- Sort the notes, fix one at a time, compare v1 and v2.
